items.description: Adds the `useTank` hook to `@williamthorsen/tank-react`, which reports a tank's status, balance, and ready time for a required amount by projecting the latest server snapshot locally, and fetches a new snapshot on mount, when the tab becomes visible, and shortly after the projected ready time. (#40)

Adds `packages/tank-react`, a private `@williamthorsen/tank-react` workspace copied from the scaffold, which does not contain any code yet, and registers its `scope:tank-react` label and its entries in the root `README.md` and `AGENTS.md`. (#38)
